description: React component 'WithLegend' for rendering a chart with an optional legend, supporting flexible positioning and styling.

classes.name: WithLegend
classes.description: A React PureComponent that renders a chart with an optional legend, managing layout based on position and styling props.

methods.name: getContainerDirection
methods.description: Determines flex direction of container based on 'position' prop.

methods.name: getLegendJustifyContent
methods.description: Determines justifyContent style for legend container based on 'legendJustifyContent' and 'position' props.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component layout, including legend and chart area, using flexbox styles and ParentSize for responsive chart rendering.
